attributes.title: 2027 Annual Meeting and Winter Refresher
attributes.summary:
Maryland's family medicine academy holds its 2027 Annual Meeting and Winter Refresher from Friday, February 26, to Sunday, February 28, at the Marriott Owings Mills Metro Centre outside Baltimore. Friday is a pre-conference day, the clinical refresher runs Saturday and Sunday, and a Key Study Assessment session on the care of children closes the program on Sunday afternoon.

Early-bird registration is open through December 20, 2026. The full Friday-to-Sunday bundle costs $375 for MDAFP members, $275 for new-physician members and $650 for non-members, and you can also buy single parts. Residents and students pay $75 for the bundle. The KSA session is priced separately.

The academy lists a $149 nightly room rate at the host hotel. Credit totals were not posted when we checked. Residents and students can submit poster abstracts until December 1.
